Rae: FYI -- Pinebridge QBR next Tue. Finance asked for a one-slide spend forecast and renewal posture.
Oliver: I'll pull 60d token history and do three scenarios (baseline, sustained pilot, rollback).
Saanvi: Quick snapshot: current period tokens = 92.4M, avg daily = 3.1M, pilot spike +42% last 8d.
Marta: If spike sustains they'll hit retainer in ~13 days. Options: short-term top-up, 10-15% retainer buffer, or auto-throttle policy.
FinOps-Bot: alert: Pinebridge retainer usage 74% of committed; projected crossover in 13 days under sustained spike.
Rae: Renewal risk? Product adoption is good but finance wants predictability.
Saanvi: Risk = medium. Recommend framing the ask as a temporary buffer with a 30-day review and an enablement session for devs.
Oliver: Proposed QBR bullets: runway (tokens left + days), 3-scenario cost chart, ask (10% buffer + 30-min enablement), SE checklist. Need per-route P95 and token distribution to plot cost/latency tradeoffs.
Marta: Provisioned emergency credits (40k, expires 12d) and left an account note. Drafted SE checklist: 1) enable prefix caching, 2) shift heavy batches to off-peak, 3) lower embed dims where acceptable.
FinOps-Bot: note: invoices and commit history at /billing/pinebridge/2026-03.
Rae: Action items: Oliver - deck + visuals (due Fri EOD); Saanvi - renewal blurb + two feedback q's; Marta - confirm credits & SE checklist; Rae - schedule QBR and invite finance lead.
Saanvi: Feedback Qs I'll draft: 1) "Would you accept short-term throttles to avoid overages?" 2) "Is a cost-vs-latency tradeoff acceptable for embedding quality?"
Oliver: I'll add a single-slide cost/latency visualization and drop early draft here for review.
Rae: Using this thread as canonical QBR ops for Pinebridge. Ping with updates. :white_check_mark:
